brief.claim: Patients with leukaemia subtype A can be told from subtype B using 60 gene expression values, with AUC of at least 0.80 in new patients.

data_keys.meaning: log expression of each gene for each patient
True for subtype A, False for subtype B

brief.sizes: 72 patients (47 subtype A, 25 subtype B), 60 genes.
